name: Zelda 64 Recompiled
description:
Zelda 64 Recompiled is an enhanced native PC port of the classic Nintendo 64 adventure titles The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time and The Legend of Zelda: Majora's Mask, created using static recompilation.

Features:
- Native execution without emulation overhead, delivering ultra-smooth 60+ FPS gameplay
- True widescreen and ultrawide monitor rendering with scalable high-definition graphics
- Modern camera controls with free-look right analog stick and mouse support
- Instant load times, high-fidelity audio rendering, and reduced input latency
- Modern controller configuration with analog stick sensitivity and customizable mapping
